56.name: OS Exhaustion Flood
56.reason: Rule 56 fires on SYN flooding — half TCP handshakes without RST — i.e. exhausting a service by flooding it with TCP connections; ATT&CK lists SYN floods under Endpoint DoS: OS Exhaustion Flood.
56.source: SECANOD verdict text of rule 56 ('Probable SYN flooding attack (Half TCP handshake without TCP RST)', intact_m1 executionreports.alerts) and MITRE ATT&CK T1499.001 — https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1499/001/
